links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM-extracted medication leaflet fields, including hallucination and missing information errors
links.effect: 20 of 36 fields perfect; precautions scored 0.20, interactions 0.30, undesirable effects 0.40; errors were assignment, missing information, interpretation, false information.
links.quote: However, complex nested sections showed substantially lower performance: precautions scored 0.20 (predominantly assignment errors), interactions 0.30 (assignment errors), and undesirable effects 0.40 (primarily missing information).

unlisted_practices: Template-based mapping of LLM-extracted content to FHIR resources with $validate operation

screen.reason: Evaluates the extraction accuracy and error types (hallucinations, omissions) of an LLM-based question-answer pipeline to map medication leaflet data to FHIR resources across 10 sample leaflets.
